name: anycap
title: Anycap
description: Capture links and notes, search your library, and browse folders and collections in Anycap.
author: ipang

commands.name: capture-form
commands.title: Capture
commands.subtitle: Anycap
commands.description: Save a link or note with a title, folder and tags.

commands.name: save-tab
commands.title: Save Current Tab
commands.subtitle: Anycap
commands.description: Save the page in front of your browser to Anycap.

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Anycap
commands.description: Search your captures, or see the newest when nothing is typed.

commands.name: capture
commands.title: Quick Capture
commands.subtitle: Anycap
commands.description: Save a link or a note to Anycap.

commands.name: save-clipboard
commands.title: Save Clipboard
commands.subtitle: Anycap
commands.description: Save the link or text on the clipboard to Anycap.

commands.name: folders
commands.title: Browse Folders
commands.subtitle: Anycap
commands.description: Your Anycap folders and what is filed in each.

commands.name: collections
commands.title: Browse Collections
commands.subtitle: Anycap
commands.description: Your Anycap collections, and their briefs.

commands.name: open-latest
commands.title: Open Latest Capture
commands.subtitle: Anycap
commands.description: Open the page or note you saved last.

tools.name: save-capture
tools.title: Save Capture
tools.description: Save a user's link or note to their local Anycap library, with optional title, existing folder and tags. Asks for confirmation before saving. Preserve the user's words.

tools.name: list-folders
tools.title: List Folders
tools.description: List available Anycap folders and counts before choosing a folder for a capture.

preferences.name: appPath
preferences.title: Anycap.app path
preferences.description: Where Anycap.app lives. The commands talk to the MCP binary inside it; no server, no account.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
